title: Bar Core - A
texts: A challenging core work out using a pull up bar

Hanging knee raises - depending on difficulty required these may be completed with knees rising to just waist level or all the way to chest for the hardest version. 

Bent leg windscreen wipers - each individual movement is equal to a single rep so that 5 moves to the left and 5 moves to the right are a full set of 10 reps. 

Each exercise may be completed using just body weight or adding additional weights to your ankles. 

If you wish to increase the difficulty of each exercise but do not have access to ankle weights, slow the pace of each movement down so that it takes longer to do each rep.
